policy_contract.name: clinical-write
policy_contract.description: Strict gate for irreversible writes against a system of record: no unarmed clicks, no vacuous steps, identity required on every entity-navigation and write step, a real SYSTEM-OF-RECORD effect (not just a screen assertion) plus an idempotency key required on every write, no unconfirmed effect bindings, and human sign-off for any thinly-evidenced step.
